title: Principal DSP SW Engineer
description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Santa Clara office.  The target base pay for this position is $140,000 - $200,000 annually.  The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. 
 
We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used-so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience - then we’ll be immediately wow-ed.
 
E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

Why E-Space is right for you:

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success.  Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals.  In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.  

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

• An opportunity to really make a difference
• Sustainability at our core
• Fair and honest workplace
• Innovative thinking is encouraged
• Competitive salaries
• Continuous learning and development
• Health and wellness care options
• Financial solutions for the future
• Optional legal services (US only)
• Paid holidays
• Paid time off

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Location: Fully Remote, United States
Position Type: Full-Time
Clearance: U.S. citizenship is required. The candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain federal suitability, a government-issued PIV credential, and required system access.
The Opportunity
TeamWorx Security is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to develop analytical and AI-enabled capabilities on a federal enterprise data modernization effort. The Senior Data Scientist will work with business teams, technical staff, and government stakeholders to turn mission questions into analytical approaches, build and validate models on governed enterprise data, and deliver results decision-makers can act on and defend.
The work spans multiple business lines, so priorities shift as different teams need help. This role rewards someone who can move between problem domains, learn a new business area quickly, and apply the method that best fits the stakeholder's or end-user's question.
Success in this role requires initiative, ownership, and clear communication. You will work through ambiguity, identify needs or risks before they become problems, and move work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
What You'll Be Doing

• Translate mission and business questions into analytical approaches, working directly with government stakeholders and subject matter experts to define the problem before modeling it.

• Perform exploratory and statistical analysis, predictive modeling, forecasting, scenario analysis, and feature engineering using governed enterprise data.

• Develop, validate, and maintain models and AI-enabled analytical capabilities, including documented assumptions, definitions, and data lineage, and establish whether the outputs are accurate, explainable, and fit for the decision being supported.

• Build the analytical datasets your work depends on using Databricks, BigQuery, Python, and SQL, working with the data engineering team where production pipelines are required.

• Take ownership of existing analytical products, reports, and stakeholder relationships, sustaining and improving them while building new capabilities.

• Deliver results as visualizations, dashboards, models, and written analysis that technical and non-technical audiences can both use, and present findings to stakeholders and leadership.

What We Think You'll Need

• Bachelor's degree with 12 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 10 years, in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, operations research, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• Demonstrated experience developing, validating, and documenting analytical models that informed real operational or business decisions.

• Strong applied statistics and machine learning fundamentals, including judgment about which method fits the problem.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL for analysis, modeling, and working with data at scale.

• Experience evaluating model performance and communicating uncertainty, limitations, and assumptions honestly to non-technical stakeholders.

• Hands-on experience working in Databricks as a practitioner: notebooks, SQL and PySpark for analysis, model development and tracking, AI features, or dashboards.

Nice to Have

• Prior experience supporting GSA, ideally within the Public Buildings Service, including an understanding of how PBS is organized, how its business lines operate, and where its data lives.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery, along with familiarity with data governance and production support.

• Experience as the senior analytical voice on a team, setting methods, reviewing others' analysis, and mentoring less experienced analysts.

What’s in it for you?
These awesome perks: Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Life Insurance, Matching 401(k) Contributions, Paid Time Off including 11 Holidays and your Birthday, Professional Development, Fitness Membership, and Home Office allocations, Perfo

Key Responsibilities

Required Skills

• Strong PHP knowledge.

Preferred Qualifications

• Elementor experience.

• WooCommerce development experience.

• Gutenberg/block development experience.

• Experience creating ThemeForest products.

• Experience creating CodeCanyon plugins.

• Experience with ACF, REST API, custom post types, and custom fields.

title: Language Associate (Dutch)
description:
About Avaaz

Avaaz is an international campaigning and advocacy organisation that provides its global membership of almost 70 million people with opportunities to make our world a better place.
We’re one of the world’s largest online global campaigning movements, with people from every corner in the world taking action to close the gap between the world we have and the world most people everywhere want. This includes protecting human rights worldwide, supporting indigenous struggles, saving our planet from climate change and other threats, and fighting to stop disinformation and other cyber threats from undermining our democracies.
Our model enables people to channel their voices into a powerful collective force at tipping point moments to impact the pressing global challenges of our time, from climate and ecological collapse to human rights abuses and the dismantling of democracy.
Avaaz is funded through small donations from individual Avaaz members, no big money from governments or corporations. This keeps us independent and allows us to keep a laser focus on doing what the world needs.
Language Associate (Dutch) - Part-Time Position (Approx. 20 hours/week)
This is an exciting consultant position that offers a unique opportunity to support large-scale social change efforts. Language Associates bring Avaaz to millions of people each week by translating Avaaz campaigns from English into key languages and rewriting them to be fitting to local contexts. This role requires strong written communication skills and cultural awareness that allow you to capture the heart of Avaaz ’ campaigns and powerfully translate them into Dutch language.
The successful candidate for this part-time position (20 hours/week) will work closely with the Dutch language lead and with the Member Engagement and Community Petitions teams, and they will report to an Avaaz staffer. Please note that this position is on a freelance/independent contractor basis.
Responsibilities

• Translate Avaaz campaigns from English to Dutch to turn them into strong, emotive, and compelling campaigns to send out in The Netherlands and Belgium, and to Dutch-speaking members around the world.

• Hands-on technical support for campaign development, including setting up email blasts and landing pages in the Avaaz website backend interface, and supporting the drafting and testing of campaigns.

• Looking for sources for campaigns -- finding relevant, issue-specific, supporting materials from the press, NGOs, etc.

• Monitor and enhance the Dutch Avaaz website and other tools for functionality and language errors, supporting clear and effective communication with members.

• Support the Dutch campaign team to write and edit excellent campaign materials such as briefings, advocacy letters, and press releases. Translate and/or edit other materials as necessary: Media material, content for social media etc.

• Reviewing, managing, and supporting the petitions published by Dutch members on the Avaaz Community Petitions website.

Qualifications

• Excellent written and oral communication, and translation skills in Dutch, combined with creative thinking to craft engaging texts.

• Excellent communication skills in English, the Avaaz team’s working language.

• Professionalism, efficiency, and results-oriented delivery on short timelines.

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to (somewhat) varying weekly workloads.

• Passion and commitment to global justice, citizen empowerment, and social change.

• Strong teamwork skills, comfortable in a highly collaborative culture, and a hierarchical team structure.

• Proficient in Google Suite and online communication systems (Slack, Zoom, etc).

• Ideally: cultural and linguistic understanding of regional differences (e.g. the Netherlands and Belgium), to guarantee Avaaz content can be understood across Dutch-speaking regions.

Compensation
This is an independent contractor role, paid at an hourly rate of €25,- depending on experience and location

title: Integrated Marketing Manager, AI Impact
description:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring that artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We help people understand what AI makes possible through the experiences of the people, communities, and customers using it.

We work closely with Social, Community, Communications, Creative, Production, and other teams to bring those experiences to life. Our work connects human stories with integrated marketing programs that build understanding and inspiration with our key audience.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to identify and curate the strongest proof points of AI’s impact-across people, communities, and society-and turn them into stories and programs that resonate.

You’ll be a builder and storyteller with the curiosity to uncover an extraordinary story and the initiative to make something of it. You’ll seek out people using AI in meaningful ways, build relationships, understand what has changed for them, and help them share their experiences in their own voices.

Working deeply with Social, Community, and Communications, you’ll shape stories together and build the programs, content, and distribution plans that help them travel. That could mean developing a recurring story series, bringing a community’s experience to a national audience, or turning a customer story into a program that invites others to participate.

You’ll combine strong editorial instincts with integrated marketing leadership, taking work from discovery and a clear brief through production, launch, and measurement. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable shaping an ambitious idea, facilitating a conversation with a story participant, and organizing the people and resources needed to bring a program to life.

In this role, you will:

- Find the strongest proof points: Proactively discover people, communities, and customers using AI in meaningful ways. Evaluate the evidence, human significance, and audience relevance behind each opportunity.

- Build alongside Social, Community, and Communications: Partner from the outset on story discovery, creative ideas, programming, and distribution. Align on a shared plan, clear roles, and the right moments to bring stories to audiences.

- Turn stories into programs: Create integrated campaigns, recurring content series, community activations, and partnerships that give strong stories a life beyond a single asset or launch.

- Connect national reach with local relevance: Adapt stories, formats, messengers, and programs to the audiences and communities they serve. Identify when a local story can resonate nationally and how a national program can become meaningful locally.

- Lead work from idea to delivery: Own briefs, creative development, production, timelines, budgets, partner coordination, launch, and optimization across social, owned, earned, experiential, community, and relevant paid channels.

- Champion craft and credibility: Partner with Creative, producers, and agencies to make distinctive, engaging content. Ground stories in demonstrated impact, bring technical ideas to life through human experiences, and represent participants accurately and thoughtfully.

- Build a repeatable approach: Develop a network of internal and external partners and a practical process for sourcing, prioritizing, developing, and sharing stories. Create formats and programs that can grow while leaving room to act on unexpected opportunities.

- Measure what resonates: Set clear goals for audience understanding, reach, engagement, sharing, and participation. Use results and feedback from audiences and participants to improve the stories, formats, and programs we build.

You will thrive in this role if you have:

- Relevant experience: 12+ years in integrated marketing, content or editorial strategy, customer storytelling, community marketing, or related fields, including significant experience leading complex campaigns and programs.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Principal Infrastructure Architect: Data Platform
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen-fast.

As a Principal Infrastructure Architect on our Infrastructure Architecture team, you will be the architecture team's partner to ZoomInfo 's data engineering organization. Data engineering owns the platforms and the products built on them. You bring the infrastructure patterns, evaluation rigor, and cross-team alignment that help them build and run those platforms well on GCP.
This is a cloud architect seat with a data specialty. You bring the same cloud, Kubernetes, networking, and infrastructure-as-code foundation as the rest of the architecture team, plus enough hands-on depth in data systems to be credible with the engineers who run them.
The work breaks down four ways:

•
Patterns. You establish and maintain the paved-road patterns data teams build on: infrastructure as code, CI/CD for data jobs and pipelines, monitoring and alerting, performance, and cost. You keep them easy to consume and self-service.

•
Enablement and alignment. You help data teams adopt those patterns, review their designs, and work through hard infrastructure trade-offs with them.

•
Evaluation. You run POCs of new data technologies and vendor offerings as part of the procurement and technology-lifecycle process, and you write recommendations engineering leaders can act on.

•
Shared stewardship. You take a full share of the architecture team's general work: weekly architecture reviews across all domains, standards and ADRs, and infrastructure consulting for any team that needs it.

The data estate is broad. We don't expect deep experience across all of it. We expect real depth in some areas and the ability to build depth in others as the work demands. Patterns get adopted here through leadership and communication rather than positional authority. You'll write reference implementations, open the first PRs, and stay hands-on through enablement when a critical initiative calls for it.
What You'll Do

•
Establish infrastructure patterns for data workloads. Design and maintain reference patterns for provisioning and operating the data platforms ZoomInfo runs: streaming and messaging (Kafka/Confluent, Pub/Sub), operational databases (PostgreSQL/Cloud SQL, MongoDB), analytical stores (BigQuery, Snowflake), search (Elasticsearch/Solr), pipeline orchestration and processing (Apache Airflow/Cloud Composer, Dataflow/Apache Beam), and open table formats (Apache Iceberg). Ship them as Terraform modules, GitOps workflows, and documented standards that data teams can adopt without reinventing them.

•
Build the data paved road. Today's delivery tooling is application-centric. Define CI/CD and GitOps patterns for data jobs and pipelines, and partner with platform engineering and data engineering to make data delivery as safe and automated as application delivery.

•
Establish performance, cost, and observability patterns. Give data teams the patterns and guidance to run stores and pipelines efficiently (query and storage optimization, partitioning and clustering, tiering and retention, workload isolation, right-sizing) and the monitoring, alerting, and SLO practices that make performance and cost visible. Set the baseline patterns for backup, restore, and disaster recovery of data stores, including RTO/RPO targets. Partner with FinOps on data-layer spend. Review workloads with teams against these patterns and help them align.

•
Evaluate new technologies. Run structured POCs of emerging data technologies and vendor offerings as part of the procurement and technology-lifecycle process. Recent examples include graph and distributed SQL databases, stream processing (Apache Flink, Confluent Flink), and schema management and catalo

title: Product Manager (US Cards)
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

- Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

- Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

- Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

- Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

- Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

- Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

- 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

- You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

- You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

- You'

We're currently hiring for remote team members in the following states: DC, DE, GA, MA, MD, NC, NH, NJ, OH, PA, SC, UT, and VA.

We're AWeber , a remote‑first company that helps small businesses around the world form meaningful connections with their customers and grow their businesses using our marketing communication software. We are fanatical about small businesses and we hope you are too!

At AWeber , agentic development is core to how we build. Our engineers spend most of their time designing agents and agentic engineering systems, reviewing agent‑generated work for quality and correctness, and coordinating that work across the codebase. As an Engineering Team Lead, you build a small team of engineers who do exactly that into a high‑performing, healthy, well‑functioning group, and you lead them from inside the work.

We are looking for the senior engineer other people already rely on, who leads and grows a team without losing their own hands on the keyboard. Your mission is to help a capable, curious group ship work the org can trust, move quickly without cutting corners, and consistently finish what they start.

On any given day, you could be found reviewing an agent‑generated pull request on a risky path and coaching the engineer on how they verified it, running a 1:1 that turns someone's recurring frustration into an owned initiative, interviewing a candidate and sharpening how your team evaluates new hires, pairing for an hour to unblock a stalled migration, deciding what comes off the plate so your team is not underwater, or carrying your team's priorities into a cross‑team engineering forum.

• Treat verification and trust as the real throughput limit in an AI‑first org, and hold the line on quality without stalling momentum.

• Make people decisions and difficult trade‑offs with care, and own the outcomes.

• Establish standards and inspire others, not just through your own expertise but through mentorship and advocacy.

• Default to open, transparent communication, and adapt your message to engineers, peers, product partners, and leadership.

• Stay calm and steady when priorities compete, and keep your team oriented on what matters most.

• Stay a forever learner, and grow the people around you.

• Experience owning a team's delivery: setting direction, breaking down ambiguous work, holding people accountable to commitments, and driving projects to done.

• Demonstrated ability to design solutions with AI development tools and coding assistants, and to raise a team's standard for reviewing agent‑generated work.

• Strong experience across our stack: Python, React, and TypeScript, plus databases, caching strategies, UNIX development tools, and deploying to AWS or other cloud infrastructure.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive-both at work and beyond.

- Make the wider business faster because of you: partner with commercial, customer and product leaders so the journey joins up before, during and after a build, and so what your team learns changes what we sell and what we build.

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Underpinning these capabilities is a global network of Support Groups spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement; ensuring that as we grow in Australia, we do so with the full weight of an established global enterprise behind us.

Metrea's solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving - enabling our partners to scale capacity and achieve asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

You will build and nurture talent communities, develop sustainable workforce pathways and establish external partnerships that enable us to engage critical talent well before a vacancy needs to be filled.

title: Regional Director of Pooled Customer Success
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

Location: San Francisco, Hybrid

ABOUT THE TEAM

CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Development teams install it on their repositories and it reviews every pull request, so it sits in the daily workflow of a large and fast-growing customer base. The Scaled Success team is responsible for the health of that base. It is a team of a program manager, a content and enablement specialist, a success analytics engineer and a success operations manager, reporting to the Director of Scaled Success. The pooled customer success team is the next team to be added, and this role leads it.

THE ROLE

You build and run the pooled customer success team. Work arrives on a shared queue when a signal fires: onboarding has stalled, nothing has been configured, the only active user has gone quiet, a renewal is approaching, a cancellation has been started, or a team is using fewer seats than it has bought. The signals come from our configuration maturity model, which scores every account on how deeply it has set up the product, and from the automated campaigns that escalate when a customer needs a person.

You design the queue, write the routing rules, set the response standards, build the playbooks, hire the team, and measure whether the motion holds retention in the band it covers. You work directly with the Director, the Scaled Success program manager, the Success Analytics Engineer and the Content and Enablement Specialist.

This team runs on signals, and the help arrives when the customer needs it. The person who builds it will learn how to run customer success this way from the inside, and will have the data to show what works.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Hiring and managing the pooled customer success managers, starting with the first hires in your first quarter

- Queue design: which signals create work, how work is prioritized, the response and resolution standards, and how a case closes

- The routing rules between the digital, pooled and named lanes, including the escalation path out of digital and the hand-back when an account grows into named coverage

- The playbook library, one per trigger: what a CSM does on a dormant account, a solo user, a stalled onboarding, a cancellation notice, an approaching renewal. Written with the Content and Enablement Specialist and kept current from what the queue teaches you

- The save lane: cancellation and non-renewal signals routed to a person, the reason captured on every one, and the fixable ones fixed

- The expansion hand-off: when the team surfaces seat headroom or a buying signal, the account goes to the account executive working the scaled lanes, with the context they need to close

- The team's readout: queue volume by trigger, time to first response, time to resolution, configuration movement, and retention of covered accounts, built with the Success Analytics Engineer and read monthly

- Capacity: how many accounts one person on the queue can carry, measured from the queue, and the case for extending pooled coverage further down the base as triggers and playbooks mature

YOUR FIRST QUARTER

- Hire the first pooled customer success managers

- Define the trigger set, the response standard for each trigger, and get the queue live i

title: Revenue Operations Architect — GTM Systems Builder

About Level AI

Level AI is building the LLM-native platform for customer experience. We process 100% of contact center interactions in real time to power automated QA, real-time agent assist, Voice of the Customer, and voice/chat AI agents - used by companies like Affirm, Penske, Carta, and OpenTable. This is a builder role and a manager role. You’ll spend your days in Salesforce, in Gong, and in Claude - designing systems and shipping them, not only running a team or maintaining a process someone else defined. Most of the infrastructure doesn’t exist yet. You’ll design it, build it, own it, and prove it works before anyone else has to adopt it.
If you’re energized by a blank canvas and shipping real systems - and you’ve built one, ideally with AI in the loop - we want to talk. If you’ve only maintained a machine someone else built, this isn’t the fit.
What You’ll Build
The forecast and deal engine

• A simplified, high-accuracy forecast off two sources only - Gong + Salesforce - on a MEDDICC-based commit/best-case structure with a +/-5% accuracy target and a weekly CRO cadence.

• The deal desk: pricing guardrails, discount authority, and quote governance - built to move fast without leaking margin.

• Territory and quota models: capacity planning, attainment tracking, and clean routing logic owned in Salesforce.

GTM engineering & signal intelligence

• The signal layer: product usage and intent data routed into a scored queue for BDRs and AEs.

• GTM AI agents you architect and ship - research, sequencing, forecasting, and daily pipeline briefings - productionized, not prototyped.

• An ICP scoring model that sharpens itself as deal data compounds.

The CRO’s operating system

• A live executive dashboard: pipeline coverage, conversion, ramp velocity, NRR, and forecast accuracy - self-serve, not a weekly manual pull.

• The systems and data hygiene that make every number above trustworthy.

GTM execution

• Own cross-functional GTM projects end to end (pricing changes, launches, new-segment entry) with named owners and a clear definition of done on every line.

• Partner with Marketing to keep one pipeline definition and one source of truth - no parallel systems, no competing data.

What You’ll Need

• 6+ years in RevOps, GTM engineering, or sales strategy at high-growth B2B SaaS/AI - ideally through the $20M-$100M ARR scaling phase.

• Hands-on builder. You’ve personally built forecasts, routing logic, deal-desk rules, dashboards, or GTM automations - not just directed a team that did.

• Deep, working fluency in Salesforce and Gong; strong analytical and systems-design instincts.

• A bias toward shipping and finishing: you scope tightly, deliver, and close the loop rather than leaving projects at 80%.

• Comfort building with AI tooling (Claude, agents, LLM-driven workflows) as a core part of the stack, not a novelty.

• Able to influence a tenured, change-resistant seller base by proving value first, then driving adoption.

Nice to Have

• CPQ / Salesforce architecture depth.

• Experience with outbound data infrastructure (enrichment, sequencing, intent).

• Enterprise sales motion and complex-deal support.

This is a zero-to-one, builder-first role. If you want to run a team, this isn’t it. If you want to build the system a great team will run on,

About Stonebranch :
Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration. No matter the degree of automation, the Stonebranch platform is simple, modern, and secure. Using Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC), enterprises can seamlessly orchestrate workloads and data across hybrid IT environments. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with points of contact and support throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Stonebranch serves some of the world’s largest financial, manufacturing, healthcare, travel, transportation, energy, and technology institutions.
Your Part in this Growth Story:
Stonebranch is searching for an ABAP Technical Lead to own the technical direction of BatchMan, our SAP-native workload automation product. We want someone who takes full accountability for a business-critical codebase and moves it forward without waiting to be told what to build next. BatchMan runs inside SAP as an add-on. It extends SAP's native job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation for more than 160 customers, ranging from long-established SAP enterprises to early technology adopters. The architecture decisions you make will shape how the product performs, evolves, and serves those customers for years to come.
This is a role built for where engineering is heading. We are transforming BatchMan development to an AI-first, specification-driven approach, and you'll lead that transformation. Using Claude Code as your primary AI agent, you'll write the technical specifications that drive development, then direct and verify AI-generated code with the senior judgment to catch what the AI gets wrong. That leaves your deepest focus for architecture and the hard technical decisions. On a codebase with more than 15 years of history, that judgment matters most. Knowing where classic ABAP and modern ABAP differ, and where the critical details hide, is what makes AI a force multiplier rather than a risk.
You'll join a small, focused team made up of an experienced fellow developer, AI agents, and the Senior Product Manager who owns the product. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities. You will, however, make the high-level architecture decisions for BatchMan and set the engineering standards the codebase is built against. You'll also be the escalation point for our Customer Support team on complex technical issues, and you'll work directly with customers when an escalation calls for it. Because our customer base is largely German-speaking, business-fluent German is required.
Deep, hands-on ABAP expertise is essential. That includes experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on, not only customer-specific extensions. What sets you apart is ownership: the drive to make this product yours and keep it strong over the long term.
This is a remote position open to candidates based anywhere in EMEA, with a preference for candidates located near a Stonebranch office. Quarterly travel to our EMEA headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany or our Honico office in Hamburg, Germany is required. This role reports directly to the Senior Product Manager.

title: Senior Product Manager, Messaging Platform & AI Services
description:
At ASAPP , our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience-faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1.
We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job-it’s a journey.
You will own the surface where humans and AI work together to serve customers - the messaging platform, the Virtual Agent and the channels it runs on, and the AI Services that make every human agent faster and every automated conversation better. This is one of the largest product surfaces at ASAPP , and it is where the promise of AI-native customer experience is proven or lost.
You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans the Messaging Platform, Virtual Agent, the messaging and voice channels (Web, iOS, Android, Apple Messages for Business, RCS etc), and the AI Services that sit underneath them - AI-assisted human augmentation tools. You will become the go-to expert on this domain, internally and externally, and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders.
The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves - as automation absorbs more of the conversation and the line between human and AI work keeps moving. The strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target, and will bring the technical and customer depth to anticipate what the right target is as AI develops in the space.
What You Will Do

You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely.

• Own the Messaging Platform - the application where live agents handle concurrent conversations, access customer context and knowledge, and collaborate with AI. Own the roadmap for agent productivity and the human side of every AI-assisted interaction.

• Define and execute the Virtual Agent and channels roadmap. Own how customers deploy automated conversations across Web, mobile SDKs, Apple Messages for Business, WhatsApp, RCS and voice, and how those channels stay coherent as the platform grows.

• Lead the AI Services that power the surface - such as automatic conversation summary, voice-to-text transcription and AI-augmented response generation. Own how these services improve agent handle time, quality, and compliance, and decide where to invest as model capabilities change. Reason directly about accuracy, latency, and trust tradeoffs rather than treating them as engineering-only concerns.

• Be the go-to expert on Human + AI collaboration. Represent this surface to customers and account teams, translate their pain into a prioritized roadmap, and be the internal source of truth on how these products work and where they are going.

• Own the external documentation for this surface as part of the product. Drive a docs-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them.
Across all of these areas:

• Set strategy and own the roadmap - balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets.

• Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery.

• Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage customer asks with product evolution bets; say no with clarity and evidence.

• Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data-driven

title: Senior Director, Partner Data
description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.

The Impact You Will Make
Risepoint's Partner Data organization is the operational backbone connecting more than 100 university partners to accurate, timely student and program data. We are seeking a Senior Director, Partner Data Integrations & Operations to lead this organization through its next stage: Reshaping two dedicated teams - Partner Data Operations and Partner Data Enablement, so day-to-day case resolution and forward-looking partner enablement each run to a higher standard.
In this role, you will lead a team who resolve partner data issues, run the recurring processes that keep partner systems in sync, and deliver new partner launches and relaunches. You will transform the team into a Partner Data Integrations & Operations team that runs disciplined, well-governed case management and monitoring, and a Partner Enablement Data team that gets ahead of partner needs - owning onboarding, relaunches, and acting as the systems subject matter expert for partner data integrations. Across both teams, you will instill a product mindset - ensuring day-to-day issue resolution and partner enablement work continually surface and drive broader improvements to Risepoint's partner data products and integrations, not just close individual cases.
The ideal candidate pairs technical fluency in SIS systems and integrations with hands-on operations leadership, ideally built in ed-tech, higher education, or another partner-based, data-intensive environment. • Set clear service-level standards and escalation rules for the Partner Data Integrations & Operations team, collaborating with Enterprise Data, Partner Support, SSC, and CRM, replacing today's informal, case-by-case routing.

• Drive automation and process redesign to cut repeat, low-judgment case volume and free the team for higher-value work.

title: Offering Tools Finance Lead
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Offering Tools Finance Lead

Purpose

Everpure is looking for a Business Case Finance Lead to build the financial models behind customer business cases. You will build CFO-grade, repeatable and standardised value logic for products across Everpure's portfolio, and own the assumptions, benchmarks and inputs that keep those models accurate. The models feed directly into our wider automated sales operating model, so sellers everywhere present customers with the same credible, defensible numbers.

These models will underpin the proposals used across the entire sales organisation, and form the core of the business cases that go in front of customers. They will cover a wide range of deal sizes, products and industries, so they need to be consistent, robust and adaptable.

The role has three parts:

• Identify the value. Understand how each product creates measurable value for customers, across cost efficiency, growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.

• Build the model. Convert that value into a repeatable, standardised financial model, including cash flow, P&L and return metrics, that works across accounts and deal sizes.

• Tell the financial story. Translate the model and its outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that increases the impact of every proposal with customers, including their CFOs and finance teams.

What Success Looks Like

• Credible, robust and accurate financial models underpin the portfolio of Everpure products.

• Models are repeatable and standardised, and can be fed into customer proposals through our wider automated operating model.

• Models and financials are translated into a compelling financial narrative that resonates with customers, including CFOs and finance teams.

• Governance is in place around model inputs, with assumptions validated, updated and maintained.

• Existing models are continually refined as new data is collected and new products are released.

What You'll Be Doing

Value and Financial Models

• Identify how each product creates measurable value for customers across the key value levers: cost efficiency, revenue growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.

• Build CFO-grade financial models, including cash flow and P&L, for each product across the portfolio.

• Standardise models around common inputs and outputs, so they can be repeated efficiently and consistently across accounts and products.

• Apply a consistent methodology and accounting treatment, with ROI, TCO, NPV, IRR and payback calculated the same way every time.

• Continuously improve model accuracy, and develop new, financially robust ways to quantify value.

Financial Narrative

• Translate model outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that shows customers what the investment means for their business.

• Turn complex financial results into tangible measures that customers and sellers can relate to.

• Help sellers position the business case confidently, in executive language.

Assumptions, Inputs and Governance

• Own, govern and maintain the global assumptions, benchmarks and financial inputs feeding the models.

• Identify and add the new pricing, product advances and market trends the models need, within an agreed SLA.

• Define the source, owner and refresh cadence for every input, and maintain a clear version history.

• Reconcile model outputs against real deals to check accuracy over time.
